purpose: Shared studio memory: our conventions, norms, processes, creative philosophy and what we put into the world. Use relevant context to work coherently across chats without repeatedly researching everything.

entries.title: How we roll: preserve shared contracts
entries.summary: Main is the source of truth; work branches and PRs target main. Inspect canonical contracts and actual state before changing branches, release routes, data, auth or cross-chat processes. Incidental chat remarks, feedback and Oracle suggestions do not authorize retiring main or replacing shared systems. Explain conflicts and downstream impact; require specific direction for an otherwise unauthorized consequential change. Routine reversible work proceeds. Preserve others' work and record intentional convention changes in their existing source of truth.

entries.title: Make imagination come alive
entries.summary: A living, responsive world that contributes imagination: a spoken story becomes a beautiful place, meaningful choices and shared play. Preserve emotional intention and character continuity as technology improves.

entries.title: A tactile living toy world
entries.summary: Warm saturated colour, chunky readable silhouettes, miniature materials and crafted composition. Arrival is unpack, reveal, come alive, play. Place-specific art, light, music and behavior should express one coherent mood.

entries.title: Simple actions, consequential play
entries.summary: A few clear verbs, immediate visible response, gentle retries and child-readable cause and effect. Tiles create; cards act as a god; controls operate the app; FPS inhabits the shared avatar. Keep precision controls out of the fiction.

entries.title: Let the world communicate
entries.summary: Use behavior, objects and sound before overlay. World and presentation are separate. No engine gizmos, debug labels, haze or white masks in play. Grown-up tools use collapsible left navigation and right drawers, with the world prominent on phones.

entries.title: Intent survives implementation
entries.summary: Preserve briefs, provenance, recipes, revisions and decisions. Reuse the shared simulation and asset systems. A study or successful deploy is not proof of a live game: scene registration and passing end-to-end play are required. Catalogue audio only; designed ElevenLabs voices.

entries.title: Learn from actual production
entries.summary: School Jump records about twenty minutes from first story to playable preview. Its lessons: establish the visual reference and layout early, compose reusable mechanics, bound placement loops, test every phase, and compare fixed camera shots. These are a dated report, not a promise of current performance.

entries.title: Preserve the original and its meaning
entries.summary: Keep feedback wording, reviewed build, time and source, then distinguish interpretation, decision, implementation and verification. A complaint is not resolved because it was summarized. Raw photos, audio and recordings remain private.

entries.title: Learn mechanics from cited moments
entries.summary: Carwash reference digest: sponge creates local foam at 05:10; hose exposes clean paint at 09:20; elevated view reaches the roof at 08:32. Adopt readable surface response and accessible viewpoints; the footage does not prove camera versus car rotation. External reference footage is not Evan playtest feedback or proof our game works.

entries.title: Use the Oracle honestly
entries.summary: Consult relevant identity, design and anatomy records; take mechanics and style, not another game's expression. Preserve the returned source and model. A studies-only template is not a model consultation. Consult on meaningful design uncertainty, not on every edit.

coverage.repo: Curated canon, Oracle contract and production review; source hashes detect drift.
coverage.app: Live observations and owner feedback can be attached on demand; they are not automatically canon.
coverage.database: Existing private feedback store is read on demand through the owner API; no new database.
coverage.video: One existing external carwash digest included. Recorded user sessions have not been comprehensively ingested.

refresh: Update affected entries when canon or reviewed evidence changes; reuse unchanged packets. Never resummarize all recordings per study.
